featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a small Railway welfare Hall which mostly caters to the welfare of the railway employees by allowing the use of this hall for marriage of the employees or any of their children at a highly discounted amount. Outsiders are also allowed the use at a reasonable cost. There are two halls in the building viz. on the Ground floor and First floor. The first floor hall is beautifully done with good decorations. It can accommodate about 150 to 175  guests. Cooking is allowed on the ground floor and there is no monopoly. its location is very good being very close to both Western railway and Central Railway Stations as it is situated between the two railways or below the Z bridge on Eastern side of Matunga  Road - and Western side of Matunga.

Its not Air-conditioned but has enough fans and ventilation to  take care of the Summer heat. Its nicely managed by the Railway employees who are very co-operative.
The sanitation requires to be improved as the present wash rooms are not up to the mark.
Its a good hall for an economic budget.

I am writing to share my experience regarding my brother’s wedding held on 19th April 2026 at 6:00 PM at Hinduja Hall, Daulat Nagar, Borivali East.

We had completed the booking in February through the hall manager, Mr. Paresh Shah. At the time of booking, we were clearly assured that the hall could accommodate 500 guests with proper seating arrangements. However, on the day of the event, we were provided with seating for only around 300 people, which caused significant inconvenience and discomfort to our guests.

Additionally, no basic amenities such as mic or speaker system were provided. Despite this, we were asked to pay extra charges for these facilities, forcing us to arrange them independently at the last moment.

We had arranged our own catering services, but the hall management was extremely uncooperative and poorly organized. Shockingly, our team was made to clean the garbage and even the kitchen area, which is completely unacceptable and unprofessional.

The full payment was collected before the function, yet the services provided did not match the commitments made during booking. Furthermore, the behavior of Mr. Paresh Shah was highly disappointing, as he lacked basic professionalism and courtesy in his communication.

Overall, this experience was very stressful and did not meet our expectations at all. We felt misled due to the lack of transparency at the time of booking.

I strongly advise anyone considering this venue to verify all details thoroughly in writing before making any payment, to avoid similar issues.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and improves their service and professionalism.

A dissatisfied customer
